text:
I do not want them to turn my little girl
into a swallow;
she flies up into Heaven
and does not come down to my mat;
she nests beneath the eaves,
and my hands cannot comb her.
I do not want them to turn my little girl
into a swallow.


I do not want them to make my little girl
a princess.
With little golden shoes,
how could she play in the meadows?
And when night comes,
she will not lie down beside me…
I do not want them to make my little girl
a princess.


Still less do I want one day
to see them make her a queen.
They would raise her to a throne
where my feet cannot reach.
When night came,
I could not rock her…
I do not want them to make my little girl
my queen!

translation.title: Fear
